verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a search engine and retrieval backend that serves data to AI clients. Consuming tools from external MCP servers is an agent/client role outside its product category. The evidence documents only a native MCP server at POST /mcp, which is the server side and cannot be credited toward this MCP-client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
